## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Scope

- [ ] Gameplay rules
- [ ] UI or UX
- [ ] API or persistence
- [ ] Authentication or security
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Repository maintenance

## Player or Developer Impact

Explain the visible behavior, workflow improvement, or technical risk reduced by this pull request.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] Manual browser verification
- [ ] Mobile or responsive verification
- [ ] Database migration or `prisma db push` documented

List any checks that could not be completed and explain why.

## Screenshots

Add before-and-after screenshots for visible UI changes. Remove secrets, personal data, and production identifiers.

## Documentation

- [ ] Root README remains accurate
- [ ] `docs/README.md` updated when documents were added or moved
- [ ] Roadmap or source-of-truth documents updated when behavior changed
- [ ] No documentation update required

## Security and Data

- [ ] No secrets, private keys, tokens, or production credentials are included
- [ ] Ownership and authorization checks were considered
- [ ] No new wallet, NFT, cryptocurrency, or custodial-key behavior was introduced

## Commit Quality

- [ ] Commits are focused and use Conventional Commits
- [ ] Unrelated changes are excluded
- [ ] GitHub Actions were not changed, or a separate workflow/cost review is linked

## Known Limitations and Follow-Up

Document remaining risks, deferred work, or intentionally unsupported cases.
